metadata.title: Negeri Sembilan PRN 2026 Live Sensory Telemetry

health_legend.SEALED_ONLY: no live market exists; sealed ground truth is authoritative
health_legend.LIVE_PARTIAL: live market probed but degraded; sealed fallback engaged
health_legend.DEGRADED: sealed file invalid or write failed; emit incomplete payload

sentiment_index.note: n=437 is below conventional 1,000 margin-of-error threshold; treat as directional proxy, not definitive estimate.

summary_metrics.voter_turnout_projection_source: Historical N9 turnout ~74% + Merdeka Center trackers + Johor 2026 comparison (69.6% Johor, N9 expected higher due to Klang Valley commuter proximity)

polymarket.note: No active N9 election market exists on Polymarket at probe time. Falling back to sealed ground truth.

ground_telemetry_seats.name: Linggi
ground_telemetry_seats.note: MB Aminuddin (PH-PKR) moved from Sikamat vs BN incumbent Mohd Faizal + Bersatu Zamri. 3-cornered. 61.8% Malay. 50-year UMNO fortress. Aminuddin self-assessed 50-50. Ilham Centre: too close BN-lean. Ong: BN wins. Bersatu candidate may eat 5-8% anti-establishment vote, helping BN retain.

ground_telemetry_seats.name: Sikamat
ground_telemetry_seats.note: Aminuddin vacated after 4 terms (since 2008). PKR's Nor Azman (political secretary) vs BN Shahrul Nizam vs Bersatu Tun Faisal. 71.6% Malay. Without Aminuddin personal vote, structural Malay consolidation dominates. Ong: PN wins. PKR machine untested without MB brand.

ground_telemetry_seats.name: Ampangan
ground_telemetry_seats.note: 329-vote PKR majority in 2023 (2.2%). 72.8% Malay. 3-cornered: PH(PKR) vs PN(PAS-Mohamad Rafie, comeback bid) vs Bersatu. B40 cost-of-living at peak. Ong: PN wins. Ilham: BN-PN advantage. Anti-incumbency + PAS grassroots in Seremban periphery.

ground_telemetry_seats.name: Klawang
ground_telemetry_seats.note: AMANAH's Bakri Sawir defending. Margin shrunk from 11.7% (2018) to 6.4% (2023). 3-cornered vs PN(Wawasan-Danni Rais, cousin) vs Bersatu. Former Bersatu candidate now on Wawasan ticket creates voter confusion. Ilham: too close. Ong: PN wins. If AMANAH loses all 7 contests, party wiped from N9.

ground_telemetry_seats.name: Serting
ground_telemetry_seats.note: PAS incumbent vs PH vs Bersatu. Bersatu fielding Affendy Salleh against PAS candidate. Split opposition vote magnitude uncertain. Ilham: too close. Ong: PN retains. If Bersatu eats >8% of PAS vote, PH wins with <40%. Complex 3-body problem.

ground_telemetry_seats.name: Bagan Pinang
ground_telemetry_seats.note: PAS incumbent (3,426 majority). Army camp seat + resort tourism. 3-cornered: PAS vs PH vs Bersatu. Military postal vote + BN-PN consolidation favors BN reclaiming. If BN wins, validates discipline-vote hypothesis. Moderate Bersatu spoiler effect expected.

ground_telemetry_seats.name: Chennah
ground_telemetry_seats.note: Loke (DAP SG) vs MCA's Siow Kong Choon. 48% Malay, 7% Orang Asli. Ilham: too close. Loke holds if non-Malay turnout >65% and OA don't swing heavily BN. Ong: too close, slight BN advantage if MCA announces exco offer for Siow. DAP machine strongest here.

ground_telemetry_seats.name: Nilai
ground_telemetry_seats.note: DAP held since 2008 (10,889 majority). 5-cornered fight. Ilham: too close. Losing grip due to Chinese voter cooling and Indian community swing. MCA mounting strongest challenge in decade. Young urban voters focused on jobs/housing.

ground_telemetry_seats.name: Temiang
ground_telemetry_seats.note: DAP held 4 terms since 2008 (34.1% margin in 2023). Ilham: too close. MCA chief Leaw Kok Chan challenging. After MCA won 8 seats in Johor (surpassing DAP's 6), Temiang tests whether MCA resurgence reaches N9. DAP newcomer Ho Weng Wah (Loke's political sec) defending.

ground_telemetry_seats.name: Repah
ground_telemetry_seats.note: DAP held since 2013 (5,950 majority). Ilham: too close. BN fielding MCA's Koh Kim Swee. Tampin town mixed seat. Chinese turnout critical — if below 60%, seat becomes vulnerable.

ground_telemetry_seats.name: Labu
ground_telemetry_seats.note: 3-cornered: Bersatu(incumbent Hanifah, N9 Bersatu chief) vs PH(PKR) vs BN(UMNO). Bersatu's best individual chance to win a seat. Won with 1,640 majority in 2023. If Bersatu wins Labu + 1 more, becomes kingmaker in hung assembly scenario.

ground_telemetry_seats.name: Rantau
ground_telemetry_seats.note: Tok Mat (BN deputy chairman) defending 7th term. Straight fight vs young doctor Azizul Hakim (PH). 10,280 majority in 2023 (72% vote share). Margin shrinkage is the signal — if <60%, BN brand softening in traditional heartlands. If >70%, BN momentum confirmed.

sovereign_synthesis.confidence_upgrade_rationale: Ilham Centre n=1,002 (3.1% MoE) provides strongest single OBS signal. Converging with Ong's structural model, Vodus directional survey, early voting data, and Ilham's 7-reason qualitative framework. Seven independent sources point BN-PN 19-24 seats.
sovereign_synthesis.confidence_delta_note: Remaining 28% uncertainty allocated to: non-Malay turnout variance (12%), Bersatu spoiler magnitude in marginals (8%), PH ground machinery last-mile (5%), adat/royal dampening effect (3%).

post_poll_audit_protocol.trigger_time: After 10pm MYT 2026-08-01 when SPR announces first batch
post_poll_audit_protocol.validation_criteria: BN-PN ≥ 19 seats = model validated. PH ≥ 16 seats = model failed.
